Get the data directories of the backends

Source: R/get_install_dir.R
get_install_dir.Rd

Returns the data directory of each registered backend. The "micromamba" backend uses the condathis data directory, tools::R_user_dir("condathis", "data") (see condathis-options for the variables that move it). Every other backend uses the directory of its name inside it, backend_root_dir(), unless it chooses its own. An example is <condathis data directory>/rattler for the "rattler" backend.

Usage

get_install_dir(method = "auto")

Arguments

method

Character string naming the backend to report. "auto" (the default) covers every registered backend, in getOption("condathis.backend_priority") order, also a backend that reports itself unavailable. Any name from list_registered_backend_names() reports only that backend, and "micromamba" is built in. The name of a backend whose package condathis knows, such as "rattler" of the rattlerthis package, also reports only that backend. condathis loads the package. It aborts with class condathis_backend_not_installed when the package is not installed. "native" is a deprecated alias for "micromamba" (warns once per session). Invalid values abort with class condathis_invalid_method.

Value

A data frame (a tibble) with one row per backend covered by method, and the character columns backend and path. path is the real, absolute path of the data directory of the backend, which is created when it does not exist yet. get_install_dir() creates no environment and does not install micromamba. When the backend that method names fails, get_install_dir() aborts with class condathis_get_install_dir_failed (also condathis_backend_error). With method = "auto", get_install_dir() skips a backend that fails, with a warning of class condathis_backend_query_failed.

Details

On macOS, when neither R_USER_DATA_DIR nor XDG_DATA_HOME is set, the condathis data directory is ~/.local/share/R/condathis, a path without spaces. micromamba run can fail on paths that contain spaces.

The data directories of the other backends that use backend_root_dir() are inside the condathis data directory. So deleting it deletes their environments and caches too. Each backend keeps its environments in the envs directory of its own data directory.

micromamba adds each environment that it creates to ~/.conda/environments.txt (in %USERPROFILE% on Windows), the list of environments that conda and mamba share. It creates that file when it is missing. To leave the file alone, condathis runs micromamba create, micromamba env list and micromamba env remove with the home/ directory of the data directory as their home. create_env() still runs micromamba with your home directory when micromamba needs something from there. It then adds the environment to your list. This happens for channel credentials that you saved (with micromamba auth login, an anaconda-client token, or a .netrc file), and for an env_file that names your home directory (~/, $HOME) or installs pip packages. Listing and removing environments never change the file, so the line of an environment that remove_env() deleted stays. Both conda and mamba drop such lines the next time they list environments. A ~ at the start of a channel, of a package path and of the path of env_file always means your own home directory.

The pip that installs the pip packages of an env_file keeps its cache in the cache/ directory of the data directory on Linux, which clean_cache() deletes. On macOS and Windows, it keeps its cache in your own user cache (~/Library/Caches/pip, %LOCALAPPDATA%\pip\Cache).

See also

backend_root_dir(), condathis-options

Other setup: clean_cache(), get_sys_arch(), install_micromamba(), micromamba_bin_path(), with_sandbox_dir()

Examples

condathis::with_sandbox_dir({
  # One row per backend: its name and its data directory,
  # <data dir>/R/condathis for micromamba
  print(condathis::get_install_dir())
})
#> # A tibble: 1 × 2
#>   backend    path                                                           
#>   <chr>      <chr>                                                          
#> 1 micromamba /tmp/Rtmpu60vo2/condathis-sandbox-2b1262d99dd7/data/R/condathis
